title: Google Review Details

fields.label: Review Text
fields.name: testimonial_text
fields.instructions: The review itself. Paste it as-is — no need to add quote marks, the card draws its own. Long reviews are clamped to 10 lines on the card.

fields.label: Rating
fields.name: testimonial_rating
fields.instructions: Number of stars shown on the card.

fields.label: Service Tag
fields.name: testimonial_service
fields.instructions: Small pill under the review, e.g. "Company Incorporation". Leave empty to hide it.

fields.label: When
fields.name: testimonial_when
fields.instructions: Free text as shown on Google, e.g. "3 months ago".

fields.label: Source
fields.name: testimonial_source
fields.instructions: Shown after the date, separated by a dot.

description: Post title = reviewer name. The avatar circle colour and initial are derived from it automatically.
